system.flavor:
Interrupt the bargain and a working falters: a warded door's spell lapses, a charmed vest goes cold, an amulet fails its wearer, a sorcerer's shield thins. The one holding it sickens as it fails.

Not enough to end the enchantment for good or touch more than one.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 Necrotic Damage and suppress 1 point of its ordinary magical Defense bonuses until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of ordinary magical Movement bonus as well.
End the selected ordinary Defense bonus rather than suppress it.

rider.title: Rite - Hex
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: on a hit, the target becomes Possessed. Trigger: it receives an ordinary magical defensive benefit. Echo: it becomes Distracted until your next turn.
